description: This PHP class represents an EmployeeModel used within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system's API. It encapsulates employee data such as employee number, name, employee ID, and termination ID, and provides serialization functionality for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeModel
classes.description: A PHP class that models employee data for API serialization within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EmployeeModel with an Employee entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings.
